page.heading: Skills

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill

page.subtitle: Reusable instructions you attach to review agents. Each enabled skill becomes its own block in the agent's prompt.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.

url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from outside your team. Its body becomes instructions for every agent it is attached to — read it before enabling it.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

card.confirmDelete: "{name}" will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
card.confirmDeleteUsed: "{name}" will be permanently removed and detached from {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}. This cannot be undone.

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: A reusable block of instructions you can attach to any agent.

create.nameHint: kebab-case: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a .md file or a .zip skill folder. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.wrongType: Only .md and .zip files can be imported.
import.trustBody: This text becomes instructions in every agent you attach it to — read it fully before saving. Scripts and other files in an archive are never run.
import.bodyLabel: As the agent will receive it

reasons.extra_markdown: extra markdown file — only the main one is used

warnings.unknown_frontmatter_key: Ignored frontmatter key {detail} — skills here can't use tools or settings.
warnings.invalid_frontmatter: The frontmatter could not be read {detail}; it was ignored.
warnings.missing_description: No description — add one: it tells the agent when to apply the skill.
warnings.hidden_characters: Invisible or direction-changing characters found {detail} — check the text.
warnings.large_body: The body is large ({detail}) — it adds to every review's prompt.
warnings.skipped_file_referenced: The body refers to {detail}, which was not imported.

previewTab.caption: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

versions.diffSubtitle: What changed from v{from} to the current version
versions.tooLarge: Too large to compare line by line.
